gloss: peak earning time, busy season for making money

definitions.gloss: peak earning time, busy season for making money
definitions.explanation: The best time or season to earn money. A period when business is booming or opportunities for profit are greatest.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{観光|かんこう}{業|ぎょう}の{稼|かせ}ぎ{時|どき}だ。
examples.english: Summer is the peak earning season for the tourism industry.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}が{稼|かせ}ぎ{時|どき}だから{頑張|がんば}ろう。
examples.english: Now is the time to earn, so let's work hard.

examples.japanese: ボーナスシーズンは{小売店|こうりてん}にとって{最大|さいだい}の{稼|かせ}ぎ{時|どき}だ。
examples.english: The bonus season is the biggest moneymaking period for retail stores.

notes:
{稼|かせ}ぎ{時|どき} combines {稼|かせ}ぐ (to earn) + {時|どき} (time/season), meaning the optimal period for making money.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜の{稼|かせ}ぎ{時|どき}: the peak earning season for ~
- {今|いま}が{稼|かせ}ぎ{時|どき}だ: now is the time to earn
- {最大|さいだい}の{稼|かせ}ぎ{時|どき}: the biggest moneymaking period

SIMILAR 〜{時|どき} COMPOUNDS:
- {書|か}き{入|い}れ{時|どき}: busy season for business (similar meaning)
- {食|た}べ{頃|ごろ}: the right time to eat (ripe)
- {見|み}{頃|ごろ}: the best time to see (flowers, etc.)

USAGE:
Used for businesses, industries, and individuals. Can be used literally about seasonal earning opportunities or figuratively to encourage seizing an opportunity. {書|か}き{入|い}れ{時|どき} is a near-synonym but focuses more on the business being busy, while {稼|かせ}ぎ{時|どき} emphasizes the opportunity to earn.
